docs.summary: Tracks forward and reverse dependencies between assets. Forward: asset -> what it depends on. Reverse: asset -> what depends on it. Locked, since a build reads it on its own thread while the editor imports, and what it hands out is a copy.

docs.summary: Sets the dependencies for the specified asset, replacing any existing dependencies.
Removes the asset and its forward dependencies from the graph. Reverse links pointing to this asset are preserved.

Returns the set of assets that directly depend on the given asset.
